source_note: Time-cost categories: a band table (contract §138). A Keeper or the host names a category on apply time {band}, and the kernel rolls the minutes uniformly inside [min, max] with its seeded dice, recording basis banded. covers says what act the row is and its extent; the band question's criteria are written from it, and a row without it is malformed (contract §202). default is the figure the build-time route fill takes for a road (spec band-then-roll D6). Nothing clamps an estimate; the table is read only through the band registry.

speak_briefly.covers: A few words or one short exchange with someone present: a question asked and answered, a greeting, a card handed over with a sentence.

quick_observation.covers: A look or a listen from where one stands, or a step or two to look at one thing: a glance through a doorway or down a stairwell, a look at one object, a moment of listening.

single_room_search.covers: Searching one room or one small area: going through its furniture, drawers, shelves, a cabinet or a heap of debris.

careful_house_search.covers: A thorough search of a whole house, a whole building or a large site, room by room or part by part; not a look along one corridor or through a few rooms.

library_research.covers: Hours of continuous search through a library's, an archive's or a newspaper morgue's holdings for information not yet located (one Library Use marks several hours); not one known record brought to hand.

local_travel.covers: A journey across a town or a district between two places: a road's own time, carried by the move.

long_travel.covers: A journey between towns or a long way across country: a road's own time, carried by the move.

first_aid.covers: First aid given to one injured person: dressing a wound, setting a splint, reviving someone who has collapsed.

medicine_treatment.covers: Medical treatment of a patient by someone trained in Medicine: an examination, a minor operation, treating an illness or a serious wound.

short_rest.covers: An hour or more of real rest: lying down, a nap, recovering from exertion; less than a night's sleep.

therapy_week.covers: Weeks of psychotherapy or care for a mind shaken by insanity.

therapy_month.covers: A month of care in an institution, or of rest and treatment, for a mind broken by insanity.

spell_learning.covers: Learning a spell from a tome or from a teacher: days to weeks of study and practice.

tome_study.covers: Reading a Mythos tome: from hours of an initial skim to days of full study.

investigation_recovery.covers: A pause of some minutes up to an hour: sitting down to catch one's breath or have a drink, gathering oneself after a shock, going over notes, waiting a short while.

momentary.covers: An act of a moment: a gesture, a single word, drawing a breath, standing still for half a minute.

brief_activity.covers: A few minutes of one simple activity: a short walk inside a building and a look (along a corridor to a door, through a few rooms with a light, without searching them), a conversation of a few exchanges, a small task at hand.

record_lookup.covers: One known record, file, register entry, card or volume brought or opened and read, or one name or date looked up in an index: one item, not a search through holdings.
